daysTab.title: Calendar days
daysTab.intro: One row per day of the period, generated from the edition's dates. The title, colour and day page are editorial: regeneration does not overwrite them.

plan.title: What generation will do
plan.create: No day to create | {count} day to create | {count} days to create
plan.unchanged: {count} day already in place | {count} day already in place | {count} days already in place
plan.outside: {count} day falls outside the period | {count} day falls outside the period | {count} days fall outside the period
plan.outsideDetail: {date} — {count} scheduled activity | {date} — {count} scheduled activity | {date} — {count} scheduled activities
plan.removeWarning: Activities on those days are not deleted: they lose their link to the day and keep their time slot.

longPeriod.title: {count} day to create: the period is unusually long | {count} day to create: the period is unusually long | {count} days to create: the period is unusually long
longPeriod.description: A conference calendar holds about a dozen days. A period of several months — a webinar series, for instance — would produce as many empty days. Check the edition's dates before confirming.

empty.title: No day
empty.description: Generate the calendar from the edition's dates.

errors.slug_taken: This page identifier is already used by another day.

tracksTab.title: Special days and thematic tracks
tracksTab.intro: A track is composed BY HAND from the selected activities: its composition happens in the planner, not here. The announced period is indicative — it links no activity.
tracksTab.composition: No activity linked | {count} activity linked | {count} activities linked

empty.title: No thematic track
empty.description: Create a special day to group activities around a theme.

form.slugHint: Opens the public page of the track.
form.periodHint: Purely indicative: an activity outside this range can still be linked to the track.
form.publish: Open the public page of the track

remove.title: Delete this thematic track?
remove.description: Activities remain scheduled, but their link to the track is lost permanently.
remove.withSessions: This track groups {count} activity: the composition will be lost. | This track groups {count} activity: the composition will be lost. | This track groups {count} activities: the composition will be lost.

errors.required: Title, code and URL identifier are required.
errors.period: The announced end must follow the start.
errors.code_taken: This code is already used by another track of this edition.
errors.slug_taken: This URL identifier is already used by another track of this edition.

venuesTab.title: Venues and rooms
venuesTab.intro: Rooms give conflicts a subject: without them, the planner can only report "two activities at 2 p.m." instead of "the stand is booked twice".
venuesTab.sessions: No activity scheduled | {count} activity scheduled | {count} activities scheduled
venuesTab.virtualExplain: A virtual room accepts simultaneous activities: no double booking is reported there.
venuesTab.physicalExplain: A physical room hosts one activity at a time; an overlap is reported at high severity.

empty.title: No venue
empty.description: Declare the pavilion, then its rooms.

roomForm.codeHint: Short and unique within the venue: STAND, ATELIER.
roomForm.isVirtualHint: Tick only for a room with no physical existence: double-booking detection is disabled there.

removeVenue.title: Delete this venue?
removeVenue.description: Its rooms are deleted with it. Activities scheduled there return to the planner's side panel.
removeVenue.withSessions: {count} activity will lose its room. | {count} activity will lose its room. | {count} activities will lose their room.

removeRoom.title: Delete this room?
removeRoom.description: Activities scheduled there return to the planner's side panel: they are not deleted.
removeRoom.withSessions: {count} activity will lose its room. | {count} activity will lose its room. | {count} activities will lose their room.

errors.code_taken: This code is already used by another room in this venue.
errors.capacity: Capacity must be a positive number.

channelsTab.title: Broadcast channels
channelsTab.intro: IFDD never streams two activities live at the same time: one technical team, one feed. The channel is therefore a bookable resource, just like a room.
channelsTab.platformHint: This channel does not belong to this edition and cannot be edited from here.
channelsTab.sessions: No activity streamed | {count} activity streamed | {count} activities streamed

noDefault.title: No default channel
noDefault.description: Without a default channel, an activity marked as streamed occupies no channel and escapes the single-live rule.

empty.title: No channel
empty.description: Declare the channel on which this edition's activities will be streamed.

form.channelRefHint: Starting point for automatic live detection: @ifddoif.
form.isDefault: Channel used by default for any streamed activity
form.isDefaultHint: One default channel per edition. Setting it here removes it from the previous one.

remove.title: Remove this channel?
remove.description: A channel that has already been used is deactivated rather than deleted: past activities keep the record of their broadcast.
remove.willDeactivate: {count} activity was streamed on this channel: it will be deactivated, not deleted. | {count} activity was streamed on this channel: it will be deactivated, not deleted. | {count} activities were streamed on this channel: it will be deactivated, not deleted.

channelsTab.deactivated: The channel was deactivated rather than deleted: it had already been used.

errors.code_taken: This code is already used by another channel of this edition.
errors.platform_channel: A platform channel cannot be edited from an edition.

callTab.title: Call for proposals
callTab.intro: An edition opens ONLY ONE call — none if there is no pavilion. The criteria grid is saved with the call: a call without criteria could evaluate no proposal.

noPavilion.title: This edition holds no pavilion
noPavilion.description: Without a pavilion, IFDD opens no call for proposals. Tick "pavilion held" on the edition if this is an oversight.

empty.title: No call for proposals
empty.description: The edition holds a pavilion: open its call to receive proposals.

summary.proposals: No proposal submitted | {count} proposal submitted | {count} proposals submitted
summary.reviews: {count} independent review required | {count} independent review required | {count} independent reviews required
summary.perOrganization: At most {count} proposal per organization | At most {count} proposal per organization | At most {count} proposals per organization
summary.duration: Duration from {min} to {max} min, {default} min by default

form.extendedHint: The originally announced deadline stays readable beside it: that is what was communicated to organizations.
form.durationHint: These bounds belong to the CAMPAIGN: a COP pavilion runs one-hour sessions, a webinar series may want three-hour ones.
form.dailyHint: In local time of the edition. A proposal must END before closing — start plus duration included.
form.blindReviewHint: A committee member sees peer scores only after submitting their own. Protects against anchoring.

criteria.knockoutHint: A zero score on a knockout criterion disqualifies the proposal, whatever the average.
criteria.scored: {count} score already recorded | {count} score already recorded | {count} scores already recorded
criteria.scoredWarning: This criterion has already been scored: removing the row or changing its scale will shift averages.
criteria.empty: No criterion: the call could evaluate no proposal.

errors.title: The call could not be saved
errors.extension: The extension must go beyond the announced closing.
errors.speakers: The maximum number of speakers must reach the minimum.
errors.duration_bounds: Duration bounds are inconsistent, or the default duration falls outside them.
errors.daily_window: Pavilion closing must follow its opening.
errors.already_exists: This edition already has a call for proposals. An edition opens only one.
errors.code_taken: This code is already used by another call of this edition.
errors.criteria_empty: The grid must have at least one criterion.
errors.criterion_code_duplicate: Two criteria share the same code.

callTab.scoresAffected: The scale changed while scores exist: proposal averages and ranking will be recomputed.

committeeTab.title: Selection committee
committeeTab.intro: This list says WHO SITS, not who is allowed in: authorization remains carried by roles assigned on the edition. Adding someone here does not open the proposals to them.

noCall.title: No call for proposals
noCall.description: The selection committee is composed on a call. Open this edition's call first.

committeeTab.capHint: Indicative cap of proposals given to this member. Empty means "no cap", not "no proposal".
committeeTab.missingPermission: Does not hold the right to review on this edition: assigned proposals will stay closed to them.
committeeTab.addHint: Only people holding the right to review, globally or on this edition, are offered.
committeeTab.noCandidates: Everyone entitled to review already sits on the committee.

empty.title: No member
empty.description: Call to the committee the people who will evaluate this call's proposals.

committeeTab.removedWithAssignments: These members still carried proposals: {names}. Their submitted reviews stay on file, the rest must be reassigned.
